quotes.text: "The contact should belong to the configured address book"
"Clicking the address book button should add the contact to the configured address book"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The changed test creates a SQLite-backed target, then directly checks the popup and indicator additions against its directoryUID. It also checks edit-menu state and that deletion leaves no duplicate card. These are local destination assertions, not remote synchronization tests. Original direct preference set/clear and later accepted push/pop setup remain separate; no browser test was run.
title: The header-contact test checks both actions against one configured SQLite book
